About Me

Developer, creator,
indie maker.

Hi, I'm Andy Eka Mulya from Sumenep, Indonesia. I run NdysFortune, a small shop selling hand-built website templates — every one designed, coded and verified by me, on desktop and mobile.

I work in vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript on purpose: no heavy frameworks, no bloat — just fast, clean code that loads instantly and is easy to customise.

Beyond templates, I build Web3 front-ends and hunt bugs in smart contracts and web apps — so the sites I ship are not just pretty, they're checked properly.
